fixes.title: EOF mem_buf→spool flush in capture::run_sink
fixes.description: When using CapturePolicy::Spool, data under the max_memory_bytes threshold is buffered in mem_buf. Before this fix, mem_buf was silently dropped at EOF, losing the full output. After the fix, at EOF: if mem_buf is non-empty and no spool file exists, create one and flush mem_buf to it. This ensures spool_ref is always Some when output > 0 bytes.

fixes.title: Durable invocation lifecycle in Planner/Evaluator
fixes.description: ProductionGoalPlanner and ProductionGoalEvaluator now accept a SqlitePool and persist invocation records durably: INSERT with state='running' BEFORE spawn, UPDATE to 'completed'/'failed' on termination. Previously, GoalRepo::insert_invocation() was defined but never called.
fixes.verification: INSERT happens before adapter calls; UPDATE happens after. planner_invocations table will be populated on every real invocation.

fixes.title: Disk hygiene tooling (scripts)
fixes.description: Single CARGO_TARGET_DIR (target/scratch), CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, scratch isolation in .scratch/, safety checks preventing deletion of .git/verification/crates, disk budget guard with hard limits.
